storyboard.video_prompt: [0s-7s]: A 35-year-old East Asian man with tan skin and short dark hair, wearing a dark green long-sleeved work shirt, dark green cargo work pants, and yellow work gloves, operates a large floor sander across a completed floor of interlocking pebbles and wood slices. The camera begins at a low angle, tracking the sander's base as it roars forward—rotating abrasives glowing faintly beneath the machine, throwing fine dust into thick sunbeams angling through high windows. The man's body leans into the handles, muscles engaged, guiding the machine in slow overlapping passes. The camera smoothly pulls back and rises to a medium-wide shot, revealing his full figure working methodically, first pushing with the grain of the wood slices, then pivoting the machine for a diagonal pass. Wood yields and smooths, warming in color; pebbles are bypassed by the sander as the machine navigates around them, leaving them unsanded. Dust swirls in golden light, settling on his dark green sleeves. The camera holds steady, capturing the rhythmic back-and-forth motion, the growing uniformity of the wood surfaces, the satisfying repetition of craft. Natural afternoon light floods the spacious room, warm color grading on wood tones and stone. Vertical 9:16, documentary camera with subtle handheld texture, real dust particles visible in light beams. [7s-10s]: He pauses, kills the machine's motor—the sudden cessation of roar leaves ringing silence. He runs a gloved hand across a sanded wood surface, feeling for uniformity, then bends to inspect pebble edges, removes a loose stone, replaces it with deliberate care. The scene then accelerates into fast-forward motion—the sander hums again, his movements become rapid and blurred as he completes final passes across the wood surfaces, dust swirling in accelerated golden light, the surface transforming from rough to unified at visible speed, then smoothly decelerates to a crisp freeze-frame on a wide shot of him standing at the room's center, looking down at the completed floor, the machine silent beside him, dust still settling in sunbeams.

storyboard.title: Space Comes Alive
storyboard.script: The sanded floor gleams. Now two workers in matching dark green carry a white sofa—clean lines, modern silhouette—across the completed surface. The man guides one end, yellow gloves gripping underneath, muscles tensing as they lower it precisely where wood slices form a natural seating area. They return for a wooden coffee table, lighter tone echoing the floor's wood slices, setting it centered before the sofa. The man adjusts the table's position by millimeters, steps back, tilts his head. Sunlight pours through ocean-view windows onto the finished floor, white fabric, warm wood. The space breathes: construction becomes home. He removes his gloves slowly, tucks them in his pocket, and allows himself a small, private smile. 'Some things take time to feel right,' he might think, 'but when they do—you know.'

storyboard.camera: Smooth dolly following furniture movement; static wide for final composition. Slow zoom out to reveal complete scene. Contemplative, earned stillness.

Black railings of the second-floor mezzanine slice across the upper frame. Their movements blur slightly—time-lapse energy of physical labor. No faces visible, just the rhythm of work: lift, pour, spread. The space breathes luxury even in its raw state, white walls and warm wood tones awaiting completion.

storyboard.title: Wood Meets Stone
storyboard.script: The same workers now place and adjust thick circular wood slices among the pebble beds, creating an organic decorative path. One man lifts a heavy round timber slice from a stack, carries it three steps, kneels to nestle it into the stone pattern. Another follows with smaller wood rounds, fitting gaps like puzzle pieces. Their boots crush softly on loose stone. The contrast is deliberate—raw bark edges against smooth gray river rock, nature's materials curated into design. The man wipes sweat from his temple with a gloved wrist, never breaking rhythm. The path begins to emerge: stone, wood, stone, wood, winding toward the ocean view.

storyboard.title: Pouring the Resin
storyboard.script: The man lifts a black bucket with both hands, tilting it over the stone-filled mold. Thick blue-green resin pours in a steady stream, cascading between the white stones, filling every crevice and gap. The liquid pools and spreads, transforming the rough stone surface into something fluid and alive. He controls the pour with practiced patience, moving the bucket in a slow arc to ensure even coverage. The color contrast is striking—vivid turquoise against pale gray-white stone. The resin slowly levels, submerging the stones halfway, creating that distinctive mosaic terrazzo effect.

storyboard.title: Preparation & Layout
storyboard.script: A 35-year-old East Asian man in a gray short-sleeved work shirt and white work gloves kneels on an irregular stone patio. He positions a black square wooden mold at the center of the frame, then uses both hands to spread white and light-gray stones from a pile into a rough layer beside the mold. A black rubber bucket and trowel rest nearby. He selects individual stones, examining their flat faces, and begins placing them one by one into the mold's interior. The camera captures the methodical rhythm of his gloved fingers rotating each stone to find its best fit, the white碎石 contrasting against the dark wood frame. Sunlight casts sharp shadows across the patio. No dialogue.

He moves systematically across the surface, tilting the grinder for edge work. Water or fine slurry appears as the polish progresses. The once-matte surface transforms to glass-smooth, individual stone faces emerging luminous under the abrasive action.

storyboard.title: Mixing the Green Blend
storyboard.script: Close-up on hands plunging into a large white container filled with thick green mixture. The woman kneels beside the container in a sunlit garden courtyard, fountain and pink roses visible in soft background. Her gloved hands grip a wooden paddle, stirring in circular motions—wrists rotating, mixture folding over itself. The green substance is viscous, clinging to the paddle as she lifts it briefly before submerging again. Bubbles form on the surface. She pauses to scrape residue from the paddle edge with her thumb, then resumes stirring more vigorously. The mixture's consistency changes slightly, becoming smoother. Her braid swings forward as she leans into the work.

Each squeeze releases more dye, the fabric gradually taking on an even, deep green tone.

**场景/环境**：室内/影棚环境，纯白色背景，突出展示家具产品。

**主体**：一张深蓝色布艺单人沙发椅，带有木质椅腿；靠背部分可见一个蓝白花卉图案的靠垫。沙发椅呈悬浮/下落状态，展示产品动态组装或分解效果。

**构图/镜头**：中景特写，平视角度，沙发椅位于画面中心偏下位置，上方部件（靠背）与下方主体分离，呈现产品拆分展示效果。

**光线/色彩**：明亮均匀的影棚灯光，无明显阴影；主色调为深蓝色与纯白色对比，搭配原木色椅腿，整体色彩简洁现代。

**文字/字幕**：画面右下角有蓝绿色矩形标签，白色文字显示"FEATURING OUR"及下方较小的"Patented Comfort Flex..."（专利技术相关字样，部分模糊）。

**整体氛围**：干净专业的产品广告风格，突出家具设计感与品质感，现代简约。

storyboard.title: Dynamic Disassembly Hook
storyboard.script: The deep navy blue fabric armchair is shown in dynamic split-state: the backrest detaches and hovers above the seat body, both components suspended in mid-air against a pure white studio backdrop. Wooden cone legs remain attached to the base. A blue-white floral patterned cushion rests on the floating backrest. The components slowly rotate to reveal assembly structure. On-screen text appears in lower right: blue-green rectangular label with white text 'FEATURING OUR' above smaller 'Patented Comfort Flex™' — partially blurred to create intrigue. Fast-paced electronic music underscores the visual. The 'Wait till you see this' energy is conveyed through the impossible floating mechanics.
storyboard.visual: Medium close-up, eye-level angle, product centered slightly below frame middle. Clean white cyclorama, shadowless even lighting from large softboxes. Color palette: deep navy blue fabric, natural oak wood legs, pure white background, blue-green UI elements. Lens: 35mm equivalent, shallow depth keeping product sharp.
storyboard.camera: Slow orbital dolly around the suspended components, 15° arc, smooth motorized movement. Slight push-in to amplify tension. Speed: slow enough to register details, fast enough to maintain energy.

storyboard.script: Extreme close-up on the seat cushion's exploded cross-section: five distinct layers hover in vertical sequence — white top surface layer, grey textured layer, thick white foam layer, thin light grey layer, and cream-white base layer with visible blue spring structures embedded. Each layer separates by 2cm gaps to reveal internal architecture. The deep navy fabric shell and oak legs remain at bottom as anchor. On-screen text cascades: 'PATENTED CHROMSOFTSEATING®' in blue-green banner, followed by 'The Most Comfortable Seat Ever Built' in white on matching banner. A second text overlay appears: '10 FABRICS | CUSTOM PILLOWS'. The 'mattress-level comfort' promise is visualized through the spring system's mattress-like parallel.
storyboard.visual: Macro detail shot, slightly low angle looking up at layer stack. Product fills 85% of vertical frame. Surgical precision lighting emphasizes layer textures — foam pores, spring coils, fabric weave. Color coding: white/grey/cream layers read as technical/comfort, blue springs as innovation signature.

storyboard.title: Ottoman & Armchair Product Showcase with Exploded Structure
storyboard.script: OPEN on medium shot of navy blue square ottoman with four light wood cylindrical short legs against pure white studio background (0-2s). Camera slowly pushes in as on-screen text 'FEATURING OUR Patented Comfort Flex' appears in blue-green gradient bar at lower right. CUT to medium close-up of navy blue single armchair with matching floral cushion, light wood legs visible, same white studio environment (2-5s). Text 'PATENTED CHROMSOFT SEATING®' overlays in matching blue-green bar. Camera tilts slightly upward to frontal view of armchair with coordinated floral throw pillow, emphasizing comfort positioning (5-8s). Text 'COMFORT WITH INFINITE POSSIBILITIES' appears. DRAMATIC TRANSITION: exploded diagram animation separates ottoman into layers—beige base frame, blue spring support layer, grey divider layer, white thick cushion layer, and top soft cushion layer float apart in vertical space, revealing internal patented construction technology (8-12s). Technical labels animate beside each component. FINAL BEAT: layers snap back together to reform complete ottoman, camera pulls back to show full product. On-screen text cascades: 'Compact for shipping', fabric swatch options appear in corner, 'Multiple colors available' (12-15s). Clean fade with brand logo and 'Link in bio' CTA.
storyboard.visual: Pure white cyclorama studio environment, zero environmental decoration. Commercial product photography lighting: large softbox key light from camera left, fill from right, subtle rim from behind. Color palette dominated by deep navy fabric, warm light wood tones, crisp white background, blue-green accent for UI text elements. 9:16 vertical framing, product always centered and hero. Exploded view uses dramatic floating separation with subtle shadow beneath each layer. Fabric texture close-ups show woven detail. No talent, no lifestyle elements, pure commercial furniture showcase.
storyboard.camera: Smooth motorized dolly push-in on ottoman opening (0-2s, slow 15mm/s). Static medium close-up on armchair with subtle tilt-up (2-5s, 5-degree tilt). Locked frontal on armchair with pillow (5-8s). Animated CG camera orbits 15 degrees around exploded diagram (8-12s). Quick snap-zoom pull back on reassembly (12-14s). Final static wide with text overlay sequence (14-15s). All movement slow and deliberate, conveying premium quality.
storyboard.emotion: clean commercial confidence, technical trustworthiness, aspirational domestic comfort
storyboard.description: 纯白影棚中，深蓝色布艺脚凳与单人沙发椅的产品展示。从外观造型到爆炸图拆解内部专利结构，最终回归完整产品并叠加卖点字幕，完成从技术到消费转化的完整电商展示。

storyboard.video_prompt: [0s-10s]: A navy blue square ottoman with four light wood cylindrical short legs sits centered in a pure white cyclorama studio, large softbox key light from camera left casting soft shadows, fill from right, subtle rim light from behind. The camera executes a slow, smooth motorized dolly push-in at 15mm/s toward the ottoman, revealing the woven fabric texture of the deep navy upholstery. On-screen text 'FEATURING OUR Patented Comfort Flex' materializes in a blue-green gradient bar at lower right. The camera continues its deliberate push-in, transitioning seamlessly to a medium shot of a matching navy blue single armchair with a floral cushion, light wood legs visible in the same pristine white environment. Text 'PATENTED CHROMSOFT SEATING®' overlays in matching blue-green bar. The camera tilts subtly upward, five degrees, shifting to a frontal view of the armchair with a coordinated floral throw pillow positioned to emphasize comfort. Text 'COMFORT WITH INFINITE POSSIBILITIES' appears. The scene holds on this composed product arrangement, premium commercial quality with crisp fabric detail and warm wood tones against the sterile white void. Vertical 9:16 framing, product always centered and hero. [10s-15s]: The ottoman abruptly initiates an dramatic exploded diagram animation — the beige base frame, blue spring support layer, grey divider layer, white thick cushion layer, and top soft cushion layer separate vertically in space, floating apart with subtle shadows beneath each suspended component, revealing internal patented construction technology. Technical labels animate beside each floating element. An animated CG camera orbits fifteen degrees around the suspended layers, capturing the engineering from multiple angles. The layers then snap back together with satisfying precision to reform the complete ottoman, and the camera executes a quick snap-zoom pull back to reveal the full product. The scene smoothly decelerates to a final static wide shot as on-screen text cascades — 'Compact for shipping', fabric swatch options appear in corner, 'Multiple colors available' — then accelerates into a dynamic fast-forward motion through the final text sequence, smoothly decelerating to a crisp freeze-frame on the brand logo and 'Link in bio' CTA, clean fade to white.
